actual.titulo: The Murder Tapes • Things Weigh on You
actual.descripcion: Things Weigh on You | Jeffrey Franklin, a deaf 16-year-old, is found dead, and GPS data and shocking admissions give Jeffrey the justice he deserves.

siguiente.titulo: The Murder Tapes • Tape The Scene
siguiente.descripcion: Tape The Scene | Agnes Bram, an 82-year-old Middleton, Wis., woman is found murdered in her garage; as detectives develop their case, a city-wide manhunt follows, and investigators must curb public hysteria by ensuring the killer will not kill again.

lista.titulo: The Murder Tapes • Down by Fire
lista.descripcion: Down by Fire | Ryne Zahner is an inspiration to his high school math students in Arizona; his friends see him as one of the nicest people they know; a hooded murderer guns him down after a night of partying and the entire community struggles to grasp his murder.

lista.titulo: The Murder Tapes • Stay With Us, Madison
lista.descripcion: Stay With Us, Madison | Madison Wells, a 16-year-old student in New Jersey, is found murdered in her aunt's kitchen; when police look into her relationship with a 20-year-old, they go down a rabbit hole that exposes an abusive relationship that leads to a tragic death.

lista.titulo: See No Evil • He's Dead, That's How I Feel
lista.descripcion: He's Dead, That's How I Feel | In Fontana, Calif., a bizarre traffic accident takes the life of 18-year-old Cristian Dominguez Aguilar; the driver vanishes into thin air, so police turn to surveillance video for answers.

lista.titulo: See No Evil • I Loved my Daughter
lista.descripcion: I Loved my Daughter | In March 2014, the bodies of two women lie behind a grocery store in Galveston, Texas; A trail of surveillance footage could possibly reveal who killed two women and why.

lista.titulo: See No Evil • The Cookie Lady
lista.descripcion: The Cookie Lady | After a frantic welfare call, police find 79-year-old Avanell Cowgill murdered in her home; with no clues except for a trail of strange credit card transactions, investigators hope surveillance video will give them what they need to reveal a killer.

lista.titulo: See No Evil • The Three of Us
lista.descripcion: The Three of Us | Hawaiian getaway turns into a nightmare when 28-year-old Ivanice Harris vanishes into thin air; Detectives trace Ivanice's movements to a Waikiki hotel, covered in surveillance cameras.

lista.titulo: See No Evil • Come Home Carlie
lista.descripcion: Come Home Carlie | Eleven-year-old Carlie Brucia disappears while walking home from a friend's house; police discover security camera footage of her shocking abduction, and the inquiry becomes a manhunt.

lista.titulo: See No Evil • Four and a Half Minutes
lista.descripcion: Four and a Half Minutes | In Tacoma, Wash., businessman Larry Howse is killed in the parking garage of his apartment building; detectives turn to a security camera, which reveals the unfolding of an execution by two mystery assailants.

lista.titulo: See No Evil • Three Masked Males
lista.descripcion: Three Masked Males | In Cleveland, Texas, a man guns down Conbino Crasto during a gas station robbery; surveillance video sends police on a hunt for three masked suspects.

lista.titulo: The Murder Tapes • Deadly Detour
lista.descripcion: Deadly Detour | When 60-year-old Ilene Gowan vanishes, her family fears the worst; weeks later, her body turns up under a frozen bridge; as detectives trace her last steps, they uncover surveillance footage, financial clues and a killer hiding in plain sight.

lista.titulo: Homicide Hunter: American Detective • Puppet Master
lista.descripcion: Puppet Master | Investigators initially suspect a demonic sacrifice when they find a mother executed in an abandoned building; a bizarre video confession and a series of strange interrogations expose an evil conspiracy concocted by those closest to the victim.

lista.descripcion: A Mother's Manipulation | When two children turn up dead in a hot car, police suspect their mother is lying; Ranger Holland joins the investigation to find out what really happened; he confronts the mother in a series of interrogations that ultimately reveal the truth.

lista.descripcion: The Plot to Eliminate Alyssa Burkett | After the horrific murder of a Texas woman, investigators discover that finding a suspect is only part of this complex story; Peter Van Sant reports.

lista.titulo: 48 Hours on ID • The Boy Across the Street
lista.descripcion: The Boy Across the Street | A college student loses her life, and her family wages a decades-long fight to keep Steven Burns, her killer, in prison. They attend every hearing and reshape victims' rights in California through their relentless push for justice. Erin Moriarty reports.

lista.descripcion: Facing a Monster | A teenager survives a vicious attack by an ex-boyfriend; years later, she faces him in court after he murders a young mother.

lista.descripcion: Vanished | When 13-year-old Rachanda Pickle goes missing, suspicion falls on her father who has a dark past.

lista.titulo: Lost Women of Highway 20 • Hidden in Plain Sight
lista.descripcion: Hidden in Plain Sight | Detectives discover that Rachanda's disappearance connects to other crimes buried in Oregon's wilderness; they must close in on a suspect who has evaded justice for decades, but he is always one step ahead.
